name: As Event Listener
description: A framework helper that lets modules register event listeners with Symfony's #[AsEventListener] PHP attribute instead of tagged services, via a ServiceProvider that adds container autoconfiguration for the attribute.
project_description:
The "AsEventListener" module enables developers to use the Symfony attribute #[AsEventListener] to register event subscribers/listeners.

 To register an event subscriber in Drupal you normally need to create a service and tag it as event_subscriber. Symfony however defines the attribute #[AsEventListener] so developers are able to register classes or single methods as event listeners. This module brings this feature to Drupal.

 It is planned to add this feature to Drupal core; until #3376163 is fixed, this module provides a way to make use of it now.

 Usage 
 To make use of this module you set up classes or methods as event listeners using #[AsEventListener], in an autoconfigured/autowired service. Example: a class annotated #[AsEventListener(event: RoutingEvents::ALTER)] with an __invoke(RouteBuildEvent $event) method is called every time that event is dispatched.

 See Defining Event Listeners with PHP Attributes for details about how to use #[AsEventListener].
